findings.evidence: Confirmed declarations at Decomposition.lean:130 and AsAlgebraHom.lean:136,163 have no annotations; they respectively reduce an identity coefficient to 1, an action on domCongr to the pulled-back action, and an action on mkQ to mkQ of the original action.
findings.fix: Add @[simp] to these three reduction lemmas so consumers can simplify coefficients, transported actions, and quotient actions through the public API.
